summary: The 21-segment targeted cohorts preserve the main source propositions, named speakers, alternatives, rejected suppositions, and critical conditions. No confirmed wrong substantive law or named-speaker substitution found. Exceptions concern atomic granularity, uncertainty and graph/attribution completeness; they must not be treated as fully qualified data until addressed.
